title: Payments Performance Strategist, LATAM
description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies-from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups-use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Global Payments Performance Team identifies payment optimization opportunities for Stripe’s merchants. The Global Payments Performance team serves a critical role both in demonstrating thought leadership on challenging payment topics, and also partnering with our high-potential merchants to set them up for long term success. We want a partnership with Stripe to be a competitive advantage for our customers, large and small, by providing them with best-in-class technology in concert with insightful and specific advice on how to harness this technology to achieve their business goals.

What you’ll do

The Payments Performance Strategist, LatAm, will be responsible for leading data-driven discussions with existing and prospective LatAm merchants on optimisation strategies across a variety of areas including, card network costs, acceptance, fraud, and cross-border flows to start. Initially, the focus will be primarily on the Mexican market.  You will be instrumental in building our optimisation narratives/tools and delivering on our merchant engagement model. You will also collaborate with Sales, deploying your knowledge to differentiate Stripe to win deals, and partner with our Customer Success organization to ensure that merchants are successful working with Stripe.

Responsibilities

• Lead discussions with existing and prospective LatAm merchants, and provide the Sales team with tools and training to lead discussions with merchants and prospects.

• Serve as both an internal and merchant-facing expert on payment optimisation strategies in LatAm.

• Gather and build on Stripe’s wide-ranging payments expertise to create LatAm optimisation narratives/tools supported by rigorous analysis.

• Use existing tools to deploy sophisticated optimisation playbooks and analyses across Stripe’s LatAm customer portfolio.

• Synthesise and relay customer feedback and our findings to inform Stripe’s product roadmap.

• Provide feedback on our tools and playbooks to help continuously improve our self serve offerings

Who you are

Minimum requirements

• 7+ years of experience in payments or operations at a leading technology company, or consultancy in the payments industry, with a focus on the LatAm market 

• Understanding of e-commerce payments, cards based payments processing and optimisation strategies

• A proven ability to build collaborative working relationships with cross-functional teams.

• The ability to deal effectively with ambiguity and thrive in an unstructured, fast-moving environment.

• A proven ability to be a self-starter capable of driving business results without significant supervision.

• Experience presenting directly to merchants

• Serve as a subject matter expert providing both internal and customer-facing advisory in the payments domain.

• Develop optimization playbooks and stay updated on industry best practices and Stripe innovations

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

• Strong data processing, organizational and analytical skills.

• Language proficiency in Spanish

Preferred requirements

• Experience with SQL, dashboard building, modeling, or reporting

• Understanding of card network rules and regulations, local payment methods, and the regulatory environment (PSD2/PSD3)

• Experience presenting to senior business leaders

Son objectif est de former les ingénieurs de demain, maîtrisant à la fois les technologies numériques et les savoir-faire industriels. Idéalement située au carrefour de l'Europe, à 1 heure de Paris, 30 minutes de Bruxelles et 1h30 de Londres, IMT Nord Europe a l'ambition de devenir un acteur majeur des grandes transformations industrielles, numériques et environnementales du XXIème siècle en combinant, tant dans ses enseignements et que dans sa recherche, les sciences de l'ingénieur et les technologies du digital.
Localisée sur 2 sites principaux d'enseignement et de recherche, à Lille et à Douai, IMT Nord Europe s'appuie sur plus de 20 000m² de laboratoire pour développer un enseignement de haut niveau et une recherche d'excellence dans les domaines suivants :
• Énergie Environnement
• Systèmes Numériques

Le CERI EE développe des activités au cœur des transitions énergétiques et environnementales. Les enjeux scientifiques traités couvrent plusieurs échelles, depuis l'intégration de matériaux et de systèmes énergétiques innovants jusqu'à leurs impacts sur les espaces intérieurs et leurs occupants. Dans un contexte marqué par le changement climatique et des exigences croissantes en termes de QEI et d'efficacité énergétique, une attention particulière est portée aux stratégies d'adaptation et d'atténuation, ainsi qu'aux rôles du comportement des occupants et des différentes sources d'exposition.
Ce poste vise à renforcer et développer l'axe thématique QEI au sein du CERI. La QEI intègre l'étude de multiples paramètres de confort (température, hygrométrie, bruit, luminosité) et de composition de l'air dans les environnements clos (logements, espaces de travail, transports, etc.), afin d'assurer bien-être et santé des occupants. title: Lead UX Designer
description:
Overview
Consilio builds eDiscovery and legal technology solutions used by legal teams at major organizations. Our users make consequential decisions inside our products - often under deadline, always under scrutiny. The work is high-stakes by nature: decisions made inside our products carry legal weight.
We're looking for a Lead UX Designer to own design for critical areas of our product suite and to serve as a steward of our design system. Two things make this role unusual. First, you'll be working out how AI shows up inside these workflows. Second, you'll be setting the standards that hold the experience together across a multi-product portfolio, and governing how those standards get used.
This is an individual contributor role. You will set direction, and you'll have real influence over what gets built.
How this role operates
You'll partner with Product and Engineering early - shaping the problem, not styling a decision that's already been made. You'll prototype fast to explore and align, and work with Engineering to keep design and code in sync.
Our internal design team is small and growing. You'll have more ownership than you'd get at a mature design org, and less existing infrastructure to lean on.
Responsibilities
· Own end-to-end design for one or more product areas, from problem framing through delivery and post-launch iteration
· Partner closely with Product and Engineering to shape solutions early, not just execute on requirements
· Translate in-flight product strategy into journeys, information architecture, and interaction patterns
· Define the interaction models for AI-assisted workflows: how users understand what the system did, why it did it, and how far to trust it
· Evolve and maintain Consilio's design system - defining components and patterns, and setting the standards for how they're used
· Build accessibility standards into the system rather than retrofitting it
· Prototype rapidly to explore, align, and de-risk decisions using modern AI tools
· Lead or partner on user research, and turn findings into decisions other people can act on
· Make the case for design decisions and system standards to senior stakeholders through evidence and clear storytelling
Qualifications
· 8+ years designing complex enterprise or B2B software, with shipped work you can walk us through
· Hands-on experience building and maintaining a design system in a multi-product environment - not just consuming one
· Experience designing end-to-end journeys for multi product ecosystems
· Experience with Figma Make, or other similar prompt-based prototyping tools.
· Depth in interaction design, with visual craft strong enough to make the work persuasive
· Demonstrated experience partnering with Product and Engineering from problem definition forward
· Bachelor’s degree in Design (e.g., Interaction, Visual, Industrial Design), HCI, or equivalent practical experience.
Qualities we're looking for
· Systems thinking. You design for scale and consistency by default, not as a cleanup pass.
· Standards judgment. You know when to generalize a pattern and when a one-off is the right answer - and you can say no to a component request without damaging the relationship.
· Comfort with ambiguity. You can make a defensible tradeoff without perfect information, and revisit it when better information arrives.
· Influence without authority. You change what gets built by being persuasive and well-reasoned, not by escalating.
· Clarity under complexity. You can take a genuinely complicated workflow and make it feel obvious.
Portfolio
· Strong portfolio demonstrating complex workflow design across multiple web-based enterprise products.
· Work samples that showcase prototyping ability.
Nice to have
· Experience with AI driven products or designing AI powered interactions
· Formal or self-directed learning in AI/ML concepts
· Prior experience designing for legal, compliance, healthcare, financial services, or another high-consequence regulated domain.

title: Product Owner - Customer Experience
description:
Rohlik is the leading Central European e-grocer. More than a million customers buy their groceries from us through Rohlik.cz http://Rohlik.cz, Knuspr.de http://Knuspr.de, Kifli.hu http://Kifli.hu, Gurkerl.at http://Gurkerl.at, and Sezamo.ro http://Sezamo.ro, choosing from over 17,000 items delivered within hours in 15-minute windows.

How our customers shop is rapidly evolving. While our mobile app and website have long been the primary touchpoints, increasingly it also means an ongoing conversation with Maia, our proprietary AI shopping assistant already handling tens of thousands of conversations daily.

We are looking for a Product Owner to take accountability for a distinct segment of the customer journey-spanning areas across search & discovery, personalization, basket, slot choice, checkout, order tracking, substitutions, Rohlik Xtra, or Maia-and make it measurably better week after week.

WHY THIS ROLE IS EXCITING

- High-velocity deployment: Work directly with engineers who ship to production multiple times a day behind feature flags. A decision made on Monday reaches live customers by Tuesday.

- Radical customer obsession: We prioritize decisions that deliver genuine value to the household on the other end of the order, even when they are harder for us to build.

- AI-first environment: Build in a modern setup where product engineers and product owners use tools like Claude Code, Cursor, and Devin daily for fast vibe-coding and rapid prototyping.

- Multi-market operational impact: Directly influence how a single product scales across five European markets, solving complex operational seams like out-of-stocks, substitutions, and slot capacity.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN AND DELIVER

- Journey outcomes & metrics: Own the business and customer metrics for your agreed part of the journey, making day-to-day prioritization decisions that directly drive performance.

- First-hand customer insights: Talk to customers weekly through interviews, home visits, customer care shadowing, and feedback channels. Turn real observations into crisp problem statements and validated backlog items.

- Backlog management: Translate the product vision into explicit problem statements, user stories, and acceptance criteria. Make clear calls on what ships, what waits, and what gets cut.

- Hypothesis-driven experimentation: Design A/B tests with clear hypotheses and pre-defined kill metrics. Evaluate performance independently and sunset features that fail to deliver value.

- Hands-on analytics: Query product analytics and the data warehouse directly using SQL. Report weekly performance metrics and distinguish product impact from operational noise.

- Prototyping & cell delivery: Embed daily with a dedicated 3-5 person engineering cell as the voice of the customer. Vibe-code early prototypes using AI tooling during requirements analysis instead of relying on static mock-ups.

- Five-market product alignment: Balance local operational requirements across CZ, DE, HU, AT, and RO with a unified product vision, using data to justify when to build vs. when to say no.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- Product ownership track record: 3+ years owning a consumer product backlog on web or native apps as a Product Owner or Product Manager, with a proven track record of shipping features with clear metrics.

- Data-driven analytical skills: Strong SQL proficiency and experience designing and reading A/B tests. Ability to distinguish statistically significant results from noise and pair numbers with qualitative user insights.

- Hands-on experience with AI tooling: Experience using Claude Code, Cursor, or similar tools to build prototypes, along with a practical perspective on where LLMs add real value in a retail shopping funnel.

- Stakeholder management without authority: Strong persuasion and communication skills to align engineers, design, Commercial, and Operations behind product decisions without formal reporting authority.

Our culture:

- We hire talented, self-motivated individuals with extreme ownership and high growth orientation.

- We value performance and not hours worked. We believe you shouldn't have to miss your family dinner, your kid's school play, friends get-together, or doctor's appointments for the sake of adhering to an arbitrary work schedule.

- We're a remote-first team spread across time zones, so no office to report to - work from wherever helps you do your best work. Just a couple of things to keep in mind: pay is based on where you're located, and you'll need to keep a home base in the country you're hired in. So while we love the "coffee shop today, mountains tomorrow" life, this isn't a passport-optional, work-from-anywhere-on-Earth kind of remote - think flexible within your country, not borderless.

LOCATION:

- Remote - Dubai.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

As Sardine grows with enterprise clients, our delivery process needs to meet the program management rigor that clients expect - formal governance, clear ownership, and predictable reporting - while moving at the pace of a fast-growing startup, not a large legacy vendor.

You'll own the integration project plan on complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise engagements: milestone deliverables, dependencies, implementation timeline, and tracking client-specific product feature requests through to resolution, all built and maintained in close coordination with the client. You'll establish RACI and communication cadences, keep Engineering, Product, and the Solutions team pointed at the same critical path, and report honestly on what's slipping and why.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING:

- Own the integration project plan for enterprise engagements, including milestone deliverables, dependencies, and implementation timeline

- Be the client’s trusted point of contact throughout the integration: Communicating regularly & proactively, surfacing risks early, and deeply understanding the client’s requirements

- Track client-specific product feature requests from intake through resolution, so tickets filed with Engineering and Product don't get lost or stall without visibility

- Establish RACI and roles/responsibilities upfront on every engagement, so accountability is unambiguous to both Sardine and the client's project office

- Manage regular, structured communication across Engineering, Product, Integrations, and the client - and manage client expectations proactively rather than reactively

- Ensure deliverables and artifacts are organized, current, and owned by the right person

- Build real fluency in the Sardine product so you can engage as a thought partner on feature requests, not just relay status between the client and the team

- Report on project health: deliverable slippage and root cause, dependency risk, and capacity planning across concurrent enterprise engagements

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:
